description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite to verify the behavior of diffs and mode changes in a Git repository. It includes setup commands, modification of file permissions, commits, and assertions to check diff outputs and statistics.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and commands

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output for test assertions

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Changes the permission mode of files for testing

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the Git repository with specified changes
